name: uw-elective-chooser-monorepo
description: University of Waterloo Elective Chooser - Full Stack Application

scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages deploy frontend/.next --project-name uw-elective-chooser
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:preview: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages deploy frontend/.next --project-name uw-elective-chooser --compatibility-date 2025-10-09
